mechanism: Atazanavir (CYP3A4 inhibitor) may increase medroxyprogesterone levels, potentially enhancing progestin effects, while medroxyprogesterone may reduce atazanavir efficacy through enzyme induction or altered pharmacokinetics.
action: Monitor for breakthrough bleeding or contraceptive efficacy changes; consider alternative contraception or increased atazanavir dosing if needed; counsel patient on potential reduced HIV suppression.
